title.narrative: Follow-up Trade Mission Tunisia - the Netherlands

description.narrative: Following a successful trade missions to and from Tunisia to the Netherlands, Dutch and Tunisian companies established initial contacts in the sustainable horticulture and water sectors. Problem Post-mission momentum is often lost due to insufficient support in formalizing contacts, identifying specific business opportunities, and developing partnership agreements.Goal The project operates within Tunisia's business and enabling environment while leveraging Dutch knowledge and market access to create mutually beneficial partnerships addressing Tunisia's development challenges in sustainable agriculture and water security. The goal is to facilitate the conversion of trade mission contacts into concrete B2B/B2G/G2G partnerships, investments, and follow-up projects that contribute to sustainable private sector development in Tunisia.Solution ApproachThis project provides structured support through:• Networking events to maintain momentum and expand networks• B2B matchmaking sessions enabling detailed partnership exploration• Technical guidance on identifying business opportunities and formulating follow-up steps• Documentation and monitoring to track progress and identify systemic barriers• Communication and visibility to share lessons learned and success stories• The project bridges the gap between initial contact and sustainable partnerships by providing dedicated facilitation, technical expertise, and structured processes for partnership development.Country: Tunisia
